_comment: The reactivation kickoff: one personal text to each quiet partner, signed by their partner manager. A wave is drafted outside the agent loop (fam kickoff draft), reviewed message by message, approved, then sent inside the SMS window. Framework: knowledge/funding/07-kickoff-framework.md.
_mailing_address: The company's postal address, printed in the footer of every email (CAN-SPAM). Live email is refused until it is set; texts don't need it.
